why: This checker must fail when the map and the tree disagree without freezing product classifications or historical prose. Each mutation breaks a mechanical guarantee; the self-test uses an independent miniature map and tree, so live documentation may evolve without breaking test setup. The real repository is checked separately.

mutations.name: a count that disagrees with the tree is not a problem
mutations.breaks: Every number in the map. The file counts, the package counts, the bucket totals and the arithmetic between them all stop being compared, and the map reads clean whatever it says.

mutations.name: a list that does not match the tree is not a problem
mutations.breaks: Every membership claim: the embedded manifests, the script buckets, the doc lists, the root table. A file could be in the tree and in no list, or in a list and not in the tree, and nothing would say so.

mutations.name: no claim is registered and the run reports the map checked
mutations.breaks: The registry. Every claim below the decorator stops existing, the loop has nothing to run, and the checker prints its own success line having compared nothing.

mutations.name: the findings are collected and the exit code ignores them
mutations.breaks: A checker that does all its work, prints every disagreement, and exits 0 — the failure an exit code alone cannot see, and the reason this file's mutations are verified by a self-test rather than by a return value.
